annotations.title: Products cheaper from a shop in another country

description: Products whose cheapest total (goods + shipping + FX to `deliver_to_country`) comes from a shop abroad and beats the cheapest domestic offer, with the saving in the deliver-to currency (`saving_kind: "estimate"`: the difference at the prices and shipping captured at `captured_at`, with `saving_basis`; present it as an estimate, never a guaranteed result). Cross-border offers carry EU warranty and returns but support may be in another language; find_best_price shows the `cross_border` block for one product.

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

name: cheaper_abroad
